prep.summary:
Invoice-summary reporting performance work in `ledgerly/reports/invoice_summary.py` is complete but uncommitted. The implementation now loads and aggregates tenant invoices once, using one `Sum("amount")` query per account instead of querying within the currency loop. It also uses the new `convert_minor_units_batch` helper in `ledgerly/billing/money.py`, grouping by currency and rounding each value once to avoid repeated exchange-rate lookups and individual `Money` construction.

Validation is strong: all 18 invoice-summary tests pass with warnings treated as errors. The large-tenant benchmark improved from 12.84 seconds to roughly 2.9–3.7 seconds. SQL statements for tenant 73 dropped from 2,417 to 37 while preserving all 14,802 aggregate values. A separate profile benchmark improved from 38.6 seconds to 4.27 seconds, with peak memory of 184,322 KB. `git diff --check` passes; the current uncommitted change is one file with 27 insertions and 19 deletions.

Earlier work: invoice-sync idempotency race fixes are committed under `fix-billing-idempotency-race`; invoice-list pagination is implemented and tested but uncommitted. Webhook v2.8.1 is deployed and healthy. Remaining operations are traffic cutover, replay and verification of the first missed batch, then replaying remaining events and checking for gaps. The operator asked only why payment-webhook and invoice-import retry behavior differs; no change was requested. Future scope includes configurable per-account dunning limits, invoice-numbering extraction, and payment-state simplification.
